chunks: When ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad al-ʿAskarī عليه السلام passed away, al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī عليهما السلام was seen coming out of the house, and his shirt had been torn from the back and the front.

key_terms.الدَّارِ: the house; the residence from which he emerged
key_terms.الْعَسْكَرِيُّ: the epithet al-ʿAskarī, identifying the Imam
key_terms.قُبِضَ: passed away; was taken in death

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī al-ʿAskarī عليه السلام appear after the death of Imam ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad al-ʿAskarī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report describes the visible mourning shown by al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī عليهما السلام after the passing of ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad al-ʿAskarī عليه السلام. It reflects a historical scene of grief and bereavement within the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.
